neighbours.label: an H-initial name or symbol immediately after another h-word (Herbert Henry, histone H3, Hip-Hop): the second of two adjacent H items; the same token after a non-h word stays quiet
fire: The treaty was signed by Harold Hugh Mercer in the spring.
Methylation of histone H2 changed after the treatment.
A statue of Hubert Humphrey stands outside the hall.
The explorer Henry Hudson sailed up the river in 1609.
Her favourite actress is Helen Hunt, who won an award.
The billionaire Howard Hughes built the enormous plane.
They visited the birthplace of Herbert Hoover in Iowa.
The station plays Hip-Hop and soul every evening.

short: second H of an H–H pair
notes: Probes: 'Herbert Henry' 0.95 vs 'William Henry' 0.07; 'histone H4' 0.85 vs 'Protein H4' 0.02; lower-case pairs are weaker ('hip hop' 0.29, 'happy husband' 0.18, 'heated hallway' 0.03), so the pattern may hold mainly for capitalised names and symbols.
